title: cuSZp2: A GPU Lossy Compressor with Extreme Throughput and Optimized Compression Ratio
problem: Existing GPU lossy compressors suffer from expensive data movement overheads, inefficient memory access patterns, and high synchronization latency, which severely limits their throughput for data-intensive applications.
motivation: Data compression with high throughput is critical for large-scale GPU simulations and large language model training to overcome data movement bottlenecks.
method: cuSZp2 implements a single-kernel error-bounded lossy compressor entirely on GPUs using a novel lossless encoding method and optimized memory access patterns. The design hides synchronization latency through careful kernel engineering and eliminates expensive CPU-GPU data movement, achieving extreme end-to-end throughput for both compression and decompression.
key_novelty: A single-kernel GPU lossy compressor combining a novel lossless encoding method with memory access optimization and synchronization latency hiding to achieve extreme throughput.
contributions: Novel lossless encoding method for error-bounded lossy compression
Optimized memory access patterns eliminating inefficiencies in GPU compression
Synchronization latency hiding techniques in kernel design
Single-kernel GPU implementation achieving 2× throughput of existing GPU compressors and 200× of CPU-GPU hybrid approaches

metrics.speedup: 2× vs GPU compressors, 200× vs CPU-GPU hybrid compressors
metrics.other: 332.42 GB/s compression, 513.04 GB/s decompression throughput on NVIDIA A100

primary_theme: GPU lossy compression for extreme throughput
